description: Enrich a public LinkedIn person profile by handle or URL without cookies (10 Credits = $0.001 base / $0.0004 Business, 0 Credits on 404). Returns full career timeline, education, skills, headline, current employer, location, and follower count.

refresh.description: Set true to bypass the 7-day PostgreSQL hot cache and fetch live upstream (paid accounts).

url.description: Optional full LinkedIn profile URL (alternative to username).

username.description: LinkedIn profile public handle (e.g. "satyanadella") or full https://www.linkedin.com/in/... URL.

name: b2b_enrich_person

outputSchema.description: Structured LinkedIn person profile enrichment response.

freshness.description: Data freshness metadata indicating cache status and upstream capture timestamp.

age_seconds.description: Age of the returned snapshot in seconds.

cached.description: True when served from warm cache; false on live upstream fetch.

source_fetched_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when upstream data was captured.

meta.description: Request execution telemetry, credit cost, and cache metadata.

cache_hit.description: Whether the record was served from hot PostgreSQL/Redis cache.

credits_charged.description: Credits deducted for this call (0 on 404/empty/error).
